milestones.description: The bat is a small, flitting creature of the deep caves, a restless shadow that wheels through the dark on leathery wings. It hangs upside down from cave ceilings during the day, folding itself into a tight little bundle that is easy to miss until a careless footstep sends a whole colony scattering in a storm of squeaks and flapping. Bats never seek out trouble and they carry nothing of value, yet explorers know them well: a sudden flutter at the edge of torchlight is often the first sign that a cave opens into something larger beyond. They prefer the deepest, darkest pockets of the world, avoiding light whenever they can, and they grow more common around the autumn festival when the nights draw long. Scholars who study them note that bats rarely fly in a straight line, darting and doubling back in ways that make them nearly impossible to follow, and that a sleeping bat will wake the moment a player draws close. Some say that if you listen carefully in a quiet mine you can hear them chattering to one another long before you see them, and that a cave without bats is a cave that something else has already claimed. This entry has been padded out on purpose so the bestiary's right page has to turn several pages.
